name: 00_Cerebrum
notes: The vault machinery with no corpus: the operating manual, WHY.md, the OKF v0.2 spec, the knowledge-base template, three skills and 36 scripts. Build 15 changes one line: the frontmatter example in CLAUDE.md writes generated.by as librarian/<model-id> instead of naming one model. Build 13 carries a prompt audit of the skills against Claude Opus 5.5: compile agents record the model they run as, the file-tools access note applies only where a session needs it, the health check ends at its summary and names files by path, and sentences describing earlier versions of a rule are gone. Build 11 brought the 3D view. Unpack it, run python3 _scripts/verify.py, and add a knowledge base from _KB_CLAUDE_TEMPLATE.md.
